Name: Australian Snubfin Dolphin
Location: West Point Beach, Magnetic Island, QLD
Site: West Point Beach, Magnetic Island, QLD
comments:
Just after the sun had gone beyond the horizon and there was still a glow in the sky, we noticed circular shapes bobbing up
from the water. This happened over the next 15 minutes or so. We saw the circular shape at least half a dozen times, and then
saw the shape moving sideways followed by what looked like a low dorsal fin. This was within 20-30m from shore, not much
further out at most from a buoy visible there. We also saw close to shore lots of fish moving near the surface in rapid fashion,
so perhaps the dolphins were chasing them. We did not get a photo due to the low light level and the unpredictability of their
surfacing, but the shadow profile looked like them and were not sure what else it could have been.
